description: This file contains utility functions for parsing command-line arguments related to Vitest reports, loading report data, and formatting time durations.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to Vitest report options, including config file, limit, and report path.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest report JSON data based on parsed arguments, using a report prefix.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a time duration in milliseconds into a string with a specified number of decimal digits.
